reason: OverlayCenter's three-argument opacity signature is the official unmodified imaging v1.6.2 API; the library is not patched.
CUE #FliptSpec definitions close nested structs, so new Redis fields in DefaultConfig fail validation without the schema update.
isCveInfoUpdated compares CveContents LastModified and never reads DistroAdvisories; empty advisories do not cause the false result.
A normalized QVersionNumber gives pkg_resources-like trailing-zero equality, so compatibility does not defeat Qt-native alignment.
Socket part is right, but the HTTP controller passes negative perPage through (stop -2); 'always valid pagination' only holds for well-formed input.
Repr format varies by PyQt version and bound/unbound signals (e.g., Class.name[...]); name(args) form holds only for some cases.
Requirements also cover pre-6.3 engine availability, domain activation, negative indices and out-of-bounds undefined, not only return values and injection.
Flipt v1.0's proto has no EvaluationReason enum or reason field; the recalled declaration belongs to a later revision.
Literally adds two QVersionNumbers, which lack a + operator; but '+' likely meant checking both versions, so the refutation is pedantic.
QVersionNumber segments live in a QVector capped under 2 GiB, so INT32_MAX int segments cannot be stored.
Python reuses the partially initialized module, so importing parse_version early raises ImportError rather than causing an infinite loop.
golang-migrate's postgres driver locks with pg_advisory_lock, unsupported by CockroachDB, so migrations fail; the cockroachdb adapter uses a lock table.
The <= 0 guard rejects non-positive numbers, but an undefined uid passes both comparisons; positivity is validated only for comparable inputs.
imaging v1.6.1 OverlayCenter takes background, img and opacity, three parameters, not two.
open returns fmt.Errorf containing d rather than logging; since d is in the error, the refutation hinges only on the word logs.
Repr parsing is prescribed only for PyQt <5.11; the task requires the signatures path for >=5.11, not one parser for all versions.
openapiv2_schema is a MessageOptions extension; fields carry no openapiv2 schema annotations (the field extension is openapiv2_field).
The start/stop range fetches the user's chat-room IDs from uid:<uid>:chat:rooms, not a range of messages.
Plus/minus flags must control returned change types; including new CVEs when DiffPlus is false returns unrequested additions.
The route is mounted at /api/v3/users/:uid/status; the claimed /api/users/:uid/status endpoint is not registered.
Validation inside messaging.hasPrivateChat would also throw invalid-data via the API; 'must be in API' is too strong, though the gap is real.
The function is makeStructInfo, not loadStructInfo, and it keys Go fields by protobuf tag number, not by position.
Swapping the earlyinit parser is part of the fix but leaves integer gates and qtutils, version and crashdialog changes undone.
Local QVersionNumber parsing in qtutils bypasses the required single utils.parse_version helper; only the lazy-import option satisfies the task.
Default/require skips verification only without sslrootcert; when a root cert file exists lib/pq verifies the CA.
The cockroach-go crdb package exports no RetryOptions type; ExecuteTx takes *sql.TxOptions instead.
A valid user with no shared private chat gets roomId null; an identifier is returned only when a private chat exists.
Under go 1.18, go.mod records modules providing transitively imported packages as indirect requires; this go.mod has that block.
Number('123') is 123; only non-convertible values give NaN, so the rule fails for numeric strings and similar non-number inputs.
Besides routing, the gateway decodes request bodies, populates message fields from path/query params, and forwards response messages.
if (!uid) catches only falsy uids; truthy invalid values like 'abc' bypass it and yield null instead of invalid-data.
Backend BoolOr('square', false) already defaults false, so a JS default is optional; but the agent's plan is valid, refutation pedantic.
In the UnsafeEnabled=false path, code only installs exporters and maps fields by number; nothing compares struct and descriptor field counts.
Holds only if getArtworkReader's signature gains square; the task doesn't mandate that, though context shows the agent had already changed it.
getDiffCves returns updated plus new CVEs but never previous-only resolved CVEs, so it does not cover all differences.
If constraints pass but the entity falls outside distribution buckets, Match=false and the required reason is UNKNOWN, not MATCH.
Qt documents QVersionNumber::compare as a static function taking two const references, not a const member taking one.
Bootstrap go-installs tool binaries; but the agent only observed that _tools holds go.mod, go.sum and tools.go, which is accurate.
The rule returns only requested additions/removals, so updated-only same-ID CVEs are excluded, contrary to keeping them.
The controller maps uid with isFinite(value) && parseInt, so a missing uid becomes false, not undefined, when passed to the API.
